justifications.r1: 5-color mana base with mana dork slivers (Gemhide, Manaweft) and green ramp.
justifications.r2: Cascade chains from The First Sliver vomit multiple slivers; Synapse/Dormant draw cards.
justifications.a1: Homing Sliver (slivercycling) and cascade provide consistent access to key slivers.
justifications.p1: Presents lethal haste/evasion sliver swarm on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: 1 opponent untap step or immediate lethal swing with Cloudshredder / Heart Sliver.
justifications.p3: Cascading into unblockable/flying slivers creates explosive, rapid clock.
justifications.i1: Harmonic Sliver (repeatable Naturalize) and Necrotic Sliver (Vindicate).
justifications.i2: Harmonic Sliver systematically eliminates opposing mana rocks and engines.
justifications.s1: Crystalline Sliver (shroud to all slivers), Hibernation Sliver, and Quick Sliver.
justifications.s2: Living Death and Patriarch's Bidding mass-reanimate the entire hive.
justifications.s3: Sliver lords buff each other effectively even without The First Sliver.
